subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a separate opt-in `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` setting plus late-side-effect fencing as the core fix for deferred turn-maintenance stalls?
rationale: The patch is technically well-supported, but repo policy requires maintainer intent for new config/default surfaces and session-state timeout semantics, especially with an open alternative that reuses the existing compaction safety timeout.

options.title: Accept Opt-In Timeout Config
options.body: Land this PR or a close variant that keeps the default unbounded and lets operators opt into a per-task maintenance bound with fencing.

options.title: Use Existing Safety Timeout
options.body: Prefer the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101702-style approach if maintainers want one shared compaction/maintenance budget and no new config key.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold this timeout family until burst coalescing or interactive recovery policy is designed with the maintenance timeout.

recommendation.title: Accept Opt-In Timeout Config
recommendation.body: Land this PR or a close variant that keeps the default unbounded and lets operators opt into a per-task maintenance bound with fencing.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the background turn-maintenance feature and have adjacent context-engine runtime ownership history.
